<strong>Cosa trattiamo.</strong> L'autov: What we process. The self-assessment and the search about yourself stay in your browser. For public figures, EVIL queries Wikidata with the name you type and shows data already published by Wikidata and Wikipedia, without storing it.
<strong>Base giuridica (art. 6 GDPR).</s: Legal basis (Art. 6 GDPR). Reading data that a public figure has made known in their public role falls within the legitimate interest in study and information (Art. 6(1)(f)). There is no legal basis, however, for collecting and cross-referencing data about private individuals: that is why EVIL offers no searches by name, place of birth, company or alias on arbitrary people.
<strong>Informazione all'interessato (ar: Informing the data subject (Art. 14 GDPR). Anyone who collects data about a person from sources other than that person must inform them. If you reuse a profile's data outside personal study (an article, a report, research), you become the data controller: assess the legal basis and your duty to inform.
<strong>Vietato il doxxing.</strong> Rac: Doxxing is forbidden. Collecting and spreading someone's personal data (address, phone number, relatives, workplace) to expose, intimidate or harass them is forbidden on EVIL and may be a criminal offence (for example unlawful data processing, Art. 167 of the Italian Privacy Code; stalking, Art. 612-bis of the Italian Criminal Code). See Ethics and law and Privacy and terms.
